eligibility: The three preregistered DEV point-estimate conditions. The specification and PREREGISTRATION require reporting whether the CI lower bound exceeds zero; it does not turn that reported condition into a prohibition on confirmation. CI failure remains a scientific reliability limitation, not a PASS.
selection_data: Only immutable family/joint inner evaluations. No outer metrics choose architecture, thresholds, memory or native policy.
family_rule: Compare all preregistered family-selected and joint cases by mean inner HOTA delta, subject to every inner DetA guard; then mean AssA delta, fewer IDSW, lower capacity. Identical native-only and C6-native effects favor the simpler native-only model.
hyperparameter_rule: Modal complete configuration among the eight inner-selected configurations of the winning family; ties favor the lexically deterministic configuration. No new grid.
refit: Preserve winning architecture, three seeds and 30 reliability epochs; fit native reliability on actual causal P1 states from all eight train-development sequences. Reuse SHA-verified historical eight-train-sequence VAL Adapter, frozen GRU and existing VAL candidates. No backbone training.
freeze: Fit-only checkpoint SHA and complete configuration in val/FROZEN_POLICY.json before events('val') or candidate/GT evaluation access.
validation: One frozen BASELINE/TREATMENT full-trajectory invocation across the same 25 sequences, full GT/all public outputs; 2000 paired sequence bootstrap draws. No VAL selection, repeated tuning or TEST access.
